label: Bible Study
prompt: What is man, that thou art _____ of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verse: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
note: David under the night sky, amazed God notices us at all — Hebrews 2 quotes this verse.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of _____ seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
verse: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
note: A mustard seed is tiny, and Jesus says that's all the faith a mountain requires.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his _____ was white as the light.
verse: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
note: On the mount of transfiguration Jesus' face shone like the sun, and even his raiment turned white as the light.

label: Deep Water
prompt: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin _____ at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
verse: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
note: God warns Cain before the first murder: sin lies in wait at the door — yet he can still rule over it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a _____ of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
verse: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
note: 'Shew' is the KJV's spelling of show: Christ made a public spectacle of the powers he disarmed at the cross.
